verdict.rationale: Svelte's first-party AI docs describe an official Svelte MCP server that agents can connect to. It supplies relevant documentation and statically analyses generated Svelte code. The evidence is a single first-party statement, though, with no setup or connection details. Missing for 10: documented connection/setup instructions (transport, hosted vs local, client config), a list of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
